name: The Reserve Vineyards & Golf Club

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project OR_PortlandMetro_B24 (tile USGS_1M_10_x50y504_OR_PortlandMetro_B24, published 2026-04-02), clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster (kept in git, 9.7 MB); EPSG:26910 (NAD83 / UTM 10N), NAVD88 metres; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-reserve)

ortho.source: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (OSIP_2024_WM ImageServer), four exportImage JPEG quarters at 0.5 m over x 504900-507900 / y 5035300-5038300 EPSG:32610, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-reserve), placed by their request boxes and clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py ortho

world.note: bbox of the one OSM course polygon for both courses (way 136348508 'The Reserve', 1,326 x 1,665 m) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (233 m west/east, 191-192 m south/north)

layouts.name: The Reserve North
layouts.scorecard_source: The club's own scorecards (reservegolf.com/north-course/ and /south-course/), read 2026-11-12. Every row adds up to the printed totals. Ratings/slopes: the club's men's figures for Green, Black, Combo and Tan; the card gives Red and Orange only for women on the North (70.2/124, 63.3/103) and men's for the South (65.0/117, 62.1/111, 60.3/101). GolfPass (third party) agrees on every Green yardage; its North ratings differ by 0.1 (73.3/140) (North only).

attribution: Elevation and lidar: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (OR_PortlandMetro_B24)
Scorecards: The Reserve Vineyards & Golf Club
notes: Two courses on one property share one world (COURSE_BUILD.md 3.5), as at Pumpkin Ridge: each layout is exported as its own course (courses/<layout id>/) whose terrain, surface, height and overview files live in courses/reserve/. OSM maps one leisure=golf_course polygon for both courses, so each hole line carries layout=<id> (edits.json). Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-12: Green tees (the longest) built and the default on both; every water red; OB = the OSM course polygon; the driving range OB; wind 1-7 mph.
